main_text.p: Ab homine, si fructus fundi, puta agri aut vineæ, vel diripiantur, vel incendio perdantur, vel etiam termini & limites fundi transferantur.

De fructibus fundi proximi tantum quidem Deus viatoribus concedit & famelicis, ut inter transeundum tantum spicarum aut uvarum de-cerpant,quantum ad famem levandam, usque ad saturitatem, pro usu præsenti satis sit, donec ho-spitiū nacti,edulia sibi comparent ipsi. Quemadmodum discipuli Christi, etiam sabbatho spicas vulserunt, inedia coacti, ad famem propulsan-dam,Matth.12.v.1.Falcem tamen in messem pro-ximi mittere, vel humeris aliquid domum asportare, ad ingluviem explendam, vel data operā in agrum aut vineam proximi irrumpere, pro fur-to habetur. Quemadmodum idem prorsus l. Si servus,27.ff.ad l. Aquiliā, pronunciatur: Si segetem quis defecuerit immaturam, vel vineas crudas, Aquilia tenebitur: quòd si maturas & collectas jam intercesserit, furti tenebitur.

Quòd si fruges proximi incendat in agro, di-stinguitur inter incendiarios. Aut enim data operā incendium factum est; idque vel prædæ causa, vel ob inimicitias: aut casu & fortuitò, adeoque incuriā. Si data operā, longè gravior poena est. Sin per incuriam & negligentiam, (de quo casu lex Dei loquitur) ut si quis in agro suo ignem accendat, comburendarum spinarum gra-tiā, is vero latiùs serpens, apprehendat acervum proximi, sive in agro, sive in horreo, incendii author rem combustam restituet. Quamvis enim nulla nocendi voluntas hic intercessit, & qui ignem

page.notes: Page number read as 598 from the old-style figures; the first figure is the least certain. The running head is split into two printed parts, "Libri IV." at centre and "Analysis" at right. A small dash in the left margin beside "Deus viatoribus" is a mark, not text, and was left out. The reference "Matth.12.v.1." is set inline in the text, with no separation from the preceding word. Printed hyphens at line ends are kept: di-, de-, ho-, propulsan-, pro-, fur-, gra-. The paragraph ending "ignem" runs over the foot of the page and continues on the next.
